title: Skrzypiec 2007 indicative AF circumferential tensile modulus (UTS / elongation) by radial region

quantity.name: indicative tensile modulus
quantity.definition: mean UTS divided by mean % elongation at failure (Table 1 averages), computed by the authors as an indicative modulus

source.authors: Skrzypiec D, Tarala M, Pollintine P, Dolan P, Adams MA
source.sample: 132 successfully tested AF slices (39 inner, 46 middle, 47 outer) from discs adjacent to 47 thoracolumbar motion segments (T8-T9 to L5-S1) of 30 cadavers (20 female, 27 male segments); degeneration grades 1-4 (mostly 2-3)

protocol.summary: 2.2-mm-thick circumferential (tangential) slices of anterolateral AF cut with parallel razor blades from partially frozen discs, designated outer/middle/inner third; dumbbell specimens (narrowed region typically 6 x 2 x 2.2 mm) cut with curved blades; ends glued (cyanoacrylate) to folded sandpaper and clamped; test region wrapped in cling film, then a drop of saline; tested in air within 5 min (outer AF hydration 63 % -> 57.5 % in simulated tests). Preconditioning 4 cycles to ~20 % strain at 1 mm/s, then stretched to failure at 1 mm/s (~15 %/s; NOT quasi-static). Strain and stiffness from clamp separation (length L between sandpaper edges); stress = force / initial cross-section. If two specimens came from one region the stronger was kept.
how_to_simulate: Dumbbell circumferential AF slice (narrowed region ~6.5 x 2.1 x 2.3 mm), lamellae at about +-30 deg to the load axis, region inner/middle/outer anterolateral AF
Pull along the circumference at 1 mm/s (clamp separation) to failure
Report the requested quantity per region

extraction.check_notes: Discussion text p.2459: 'This yields values of 3.1, 9.3, and 18.5 MPa for the tensile modulus of the inner, middle, and outer anulus'. Derived from group means (no SD).

pass_rule.rule: |model - mean| <= 1 SD (or inside [min, max] when no SD)
